title: Email-based trigger can grant superadmin access
detail: Authenticated users may update their own profile email. The later BEFORE trigger assigns super_admin from that editable email after the role guard has run. Catalog grants and both trigger definitions are present in production; no account mutation was attempted.
action: Remove ongoing email-based role assignment; preserve existing legitimate superadmin Auth UUIDs and emails; protect privileged fields using verified identity.
basis: Live grants and trigger definitions + source

title: Authorization trusts user-editable metadata
detail: Production advisor flags 27 policies referencing user_metadata. Live is_staff_or_admin also trusts editable metadata and an email suffix.
action: Use protected database roles and exact ownership/assignment; remove unsafe legacy helper use.

title: Payment RPC trusts a supplied administrator identity
detail: Live SECURITY DEFINER reconcile_and_approve_payment is executable by authenticated and checks p_admin_user_id rather than binding the acting user to auth.uid().
action: Authorize the actual authenticated caller or restrict RPC to a trusted server role; validate amount and exact project atomically.
basis: Live function definition and execute grants

title: Old broad staff policies bypass assignment restrictions
detail: ce_auth_staff_all, es_auth_staff_all, edl_auth_staff_all and cicr_auth_staff_all remain alongside narrower assignment policies in production.
action: Replace all overlapping permissive policies with the intended access model; test roles at SQL and API boundaries.

title: Engagement reads and forms lack verified client ownership
detail: Stage GET uses reference alone; POST treats non-staff callers as clients and accepts supplied actor identity. Identity-correction POST verifies existence rather than caller ownership.
action: Apply one verified engagement access resolver to pages, APIs, document reads and mutations.

title: Alternate stage actions bypass founder approval controls
detail: POST checks only selected action names. Service admin branches accept approval/payment action variants and payload statuses without equivalent capability and assignment gates.
action: Allowlist action/state transitions and authorize every action at the service boundary.

title: Maintenance status and correction APIs disclose data
detail: Subscription status returns full orders including secure_token by engagement ID; correction GET can return recent requests across clients without an engagement filter or caller authentication.
action: Require identity and exact engagement scope; return explicit safe response fields.

title: New maintenance mutations accept caller-supplied client identity
detail: Order and correction creation fall back to body.clientId after failed authentication and do not verify engagement ownership.
action: Reject unauthenticated requests; derive identity from session and validate client-engagement relationship.

title: Client maintenance policies permit financial/status tampering
detail: Live order INSERT/UPDATE policies constrain ownership but not the sensitive columns or resulting status. Authenticated users hold INSERT and UPDATE grants.
action: Use constrained server mutations or precise column grants and immutable transitions; protect plan, amount, owner and verification fields.

title: Assigned staff can delete subscriptions
detail: Live FOR ALL policy admits assigned staff in USING; WITH CHECK protects new rows but does not restrict DELETE. Authenticated DELETE grant exists.
action: Split assigned staff SELECT from founder-only mutations.

title: Payment token validation is optional
detail: Both billing and UTR checks run only if secureToken is truthy; omitting it bypasses token matching. UTR writes also need terminal-state validation.
action: Require a nonempty valid token or verified owner context, expiry, state and request association.

title: Client UUID and login UUID are confused
detail: Financial PDF handlers and payment RLS compare clients(id) references directly with auth.users(id), bypassing clients.user_id mapping and denying legitimate owners.
action: Resolve one canonical client identity relationship and use it across PDFs, billing, RLS and payments.

title: Other admin routes expose global project and finance data
detail: Command center and engagement/support pages use broad capabilities then privileged global reads; workspace-level redaction does not secure these alternate paths.
action: Scope every query and output to assignments; founder-only financial visibility where required.

title: Expired or restricted assignments can still open project details
detail: Workspace assignment mapper filters status only and project detail does not enforce expiry or canViewTechnicalStages.
action: Enforce active state, expiry, employment and resource permissions in one shared resolver.

title: A credential is embedded in a live database function
detail: A live welcome-email trigger definition contains a literal webhook credential. Its value is deliberately omitted from this report.
action: Locate the owning function, rotate that credential and migrate secret storage to a protected secret facility; examine repository history without printing secrets.
basis: Live function definition; source location requires exact owning migration verification

title: Maintenance verification does not validate actual credited amount
detail: Paid maintenance activation takes no bank-credit amount and does not enforce canonical plan total; milestone paths check only positive credit or use fallback amounts.
action: Reconcile actual bank credit in integer paise against the approved order and record partial/overpayment explicitly.

title: Verification and subscription activation are not atomic
detail: Order becomes verified before subscription insert. Failure strands the order and retries reject it; concurrent verification is not safely claimed.
action: Use a locked transaction with idempotency and durable event enqueue.

title: Trial index also blocks paid Standard activation
detail: Production unique index includes both STANDARD and FREE_TRIAL for active/pending subscriptions, preventing a trial-to-Standard upgrade.
action: Separate trial consumption from paid subscription renewal/upgrade uniqueness.

title: Trials, paid Standard and refunds are conflated
detail: Expired trials can be repeated; paid STANDARD is labelled a free trial in UI and can enter refund processing. Refund transitions accept invented references and backward status movement.
action: Use canonical planType throughout; define trial eligibility and evidence-backed terminal refund transitions.

title: Duplicate bank-credit allocation is not prevented
detail: Maintenance UTR and reconciliation references lack an atomic uniqueness/allocation model across orders.
action: Allocate each verified bank transaction once using database constraints and idempotent operations.

title: Maintenance notifications use the wrong live outbox schema
detail: Service writes recipient_email/template_id/payload/metadata and queued; live queue instead requires recipient, sender, event_type, idempotency_key, subject and supported status fields. Errors are ignored.
action: Use the existing enqueue/send contract, actual client recipients and checked durable writes for every lifecycle event.

title: Retried messages lose required PDF attachments
detail: Immediate send includes attachment bytes but durable outbox and retry worker have no attachment references/loading.
action: Persist immutable artifact references and verify/download those bytes on every send attempt.

title: Stage emails can falsely describe acceptance or unlocks
detail: Question/revision/decline actions reuse signature/acceptance summaries; null next stage can be replaced by a guessed stage and terminal approval can refer to Stage 14.
action: Build action-specific emails from committed transitions; omit unlocks that did not occur; no Stage 14.

title: Stage notification work may not be durably enqueued
detail: Fire-and-forget notification promises let the request complete before enqueue; UI claims dispatch without checking delivery state.
action: Commit outbox events before returning; distinguish saved, queued, provider-accepted and delivered.

title: Concurrent Python renders share client values
detail: Renderer mutates process-global fill data, occurrence counters and section context, so concurrent client documents can mix fields.
action: Make all render state request-local or serialize the entire operation as an interim containment.
basis: Source confirmed; isolated deterministic agent probe

title: PDF generation, storage and downloads are disconnected
detail: Some milestone generation paths record links/hashes without publishing the generated bytes as the authoritative financial artifact; latest fallbacks are not engagement-specific resolvers.
action: Publish one immutable version and use its bytes/hash for preview, download and every email attempt.

title: Stage auto-fill is not fully integrated
detail: Registry and render-job helpers are disconnected from stage submission; template IDs/meanings differ across TypeScript and Python and many previews still use blank masters.
action: Unify template IDs and field mappings; generate stage artifacts from validated versioned project snapshots.

title: Preview modal lacks reliable geometry and keyboard handling
detail: Width plus max-height can break 2:3, native iframe hiding does not guarantee fixed-scale rendering, and focus trapping/initial focus and document state resets are incomplete.
action: Use a controlled fit-width PDF renderer without custom zoom, correct viewport-derived geometry and accessible dialog behavior.
basis: Source confirmed; private modal not browser tested

title: Some successful submissions can lose database writes
detail: Stage central writes, checklist child responses, quotation revisions/acceptance evidence and central intake can ignore required database errors.
action: Commit required form data atomically and return failure for incomplete persistence; make retries idempotent.
basis: Source confirmed; full form audit agent pending

title: Messages and project requests lack the promised assigned-staff inbox
detail: Client messages persist to conversation_messages while no complete assigned-staff reply consumer is wired; RFC staff view shows identity corrections rather than client change requests.
action: Implement shared project-scoped conversations and request queues with authorized two-way replies.

title: Support tickets use incompatible stores and ownership
detail: Stage tickets are snapshot entries instead of support_tickets; public support submissions lack the user ownership expected by client portal filtering.
action: Use canonical support records with project, client and staff assignment links; migrate legacy snapshots.

title: Discovery answers are not fully stored or exposed
detail: Checklist API persists only selected answers instead of the submitted discovery array; missing admin reader leaves records outside the intended workflow.
action: Persist all validated answers and provide a form-specific admin view.

title: Assignment writes can report success without persistence
detail: Assignment service caches before inserting and ignores errors; initial workspace assignments can warn yet report workspace success.
action: Use database-first committed writes, explicit partial outcomes and no production cache fallback success.

title: Project invitation acceptance has no matching unique key
detail: Production assignment indexes do not contain the staff_user_id,engagement_id unique target used by onConflict. Invitation is accepted before assignment succeeds.
action: Choose and enforce the intended uniqueness key; accept invitation and create membership atomically.

title: Post-creation Assign Projects control is missing
detail: Existing Assigned Projects page displays assignments; the promised workspace project picker and add/edit/reassign/revoke workflow are not present.
action: Add founder-only Assign Projects modal with real engagement picker and durable permission/expiry controls.

title: Client-only assignment can crash project list
detail: Schema permits a null engagement ID but project display calls engagementId.slice without a null-safe path.
action: Model client-only and project-specific assignment types and guard project-detail navigation.

title: Portal shells differ from the requested header and white theme
detail: Admin/client use separate sidebars, staff tabs differ, branding is stacked, and dark surfaces remain in some portal components.
action: Use shared white portal chrome with 6–8 primary destinations plus More, a logo and a single-line wordmark.

title: Directory is overbroad and not capability filtered
detail: 164 entries span 13 categories including public pages, aliases and samples; directory visibility does not apply the canonical role/capability filter.
action: Retain useful operational modules; move secondary/public links out of daily navigation; remove redundant directory entries and gate every link.

title: Client gateway points to a missing destination
detail: /client redirects to /client/workspace, which has no page; client/dashboard is implemented.
action: Point the gateway to its real authorized landing page and test complete redirect chains.

title: Active navigation can select multiple destinations
detail: Serialized active matcher discards exact-match exceptions; a hash route can never match pathname for Milestone Journey.
action: Derive active state from route metadata and handle hash navigation explicitly.

title: Maintenance comparison requires horizontal scrolling on mobile
detail: Measured at viewport390: document width390, but comparison container width360 has528px scroll content. It fails the requested vertical-only component layout.
action: Use stacked feature comparisons/cards on narrow screens; test visible controls without root clipping.

title: Trial expiry is not registered in checked schedules
detail: Vercel config lists only two unrelated jobs and production has no cron.job table. An external scheduler is not verified. Cron route fails open if CRON_SECRET is missing.
action: Register and verify an authenticated scheduler and enforce expiry during access checks; fail closed on missing secret.
basis: Live cron metadata + source; external scheduler unverified

title: Security hardening configuration remains incomplete
detail: Live advisor flags leaked-password protection disabled,10 mutable function search paths and executable SECURITY DEFINER routines requiring review. Root response lacks CSP/frame/content-type/referrer hardening headers.
action: Review each warning, enforce least privilege, stage a tested CSP and add applicable headers; enable supported password defenses.
basis: Live advisor, grants and HTTP headers

title: Lint fails despite successful tests and typecheck
detail: Current lint run has one prefer-const error in workspace service391 and835 warnings.
action: Fix the error and triage warnings without disabling protections.

title: Dependency audit still reports affected packages
detail: Current registry audit reports13 affected nodes:1critical,10high,2moderate, including development/transitive paths; this is not13 demonstrated live exploits.
action: Upgrade to compatible patched versions based on current advisories and test; report reachable production risk separately.

title: Passing tests and route report do not establish complete verification
detail: Many security tests inspect source strings. verify-links checks44 registered paths while194 page files exist. Prior repair ledger includes absent triggers and remaps earlier finding IDs.
action: Use behavioral API/RLS/integration/browser tests and a complete evidence ledger with stable IDs and honest coverage.

title: Notification filters expand beyond the verified client
detail: Listing and unread count combine verified email OR supplied engagement reference, so the engagement filter can widen access.
action: Require verified ownership before adding an engagement filter; never OR an untrusted scope into tenant identity.

title: Staff assignment and support queries use wrong column names
detail: Workspace query requests clients.company_name; support queries request client_name/client_email and stage_number/display_name/data instead of the committed column names.
action: Align projections with the live schema and surface database errors instead of empty success.
basis: Source confirmed; live column confirmation included

title: Invoice preparation can claim issuance without a real invoice
detail: Approval reads process-local preparation state, generates identifiers and marks approved_and_issued without inserting the corresponding invoice.
action: Load durable preparation records and transactionally create/link the real invoice before reporting issuance.

title: Staff notes and escalations are not durable
detail: Support note/escalation services acknowledge process-local Map records without a persistent review queue.
action: Persist author-attributed project notes and escalation events and verify read-after-write across workers.

title: Technical drafts remain process-dependent
detail: Draft listing uses a Map and edits update memory, losing changes across workers or restarts despite an attempted initial database write.
action: Implement database-backed listing/editing with explicit errors and version control.

title: Support history and operational claims can be fabricated
detail: Stage13 creates a resolved baseline ticket when initialData has no tickets; warranty, telemetry and delivered-asset statements also need actual persisted evidence.
action: Use genuine empty states and calculate warranty/support/asset status from approved project records.
